articles.title: Mark Cuban says he sold most of his Bitcoin after failed hedge narrative 'disappointed' the billionaire
articles.snippet: The billionaire investor said he sold most of his bitcoin after concluding the cryptocurrency failed to act as a hedge during recent geopolitical turmoil and dollar weakness.

articles.title: Stablecoins retain the edge over tokenized money market funds, JPMorgan says
articles.snippet: The bank said tokenized money market funds account for only about 5% of the broader stablecoin universe despite offering yield.

articles.title: Trump Halts AI Order Over Fears It Could Hurt US Edge Over China
articles.snippet: Trump said he delayed the order because parts of the proposal risked slowing the U.S. AI industry as competition with China intensifies.
